## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his finest clothes, sparking her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) on the farm. Mrs. Rachel expresses strong disapproval and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the risks involved before departing to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spend a quiet evening together studying and talking. [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) rushes in to beg for help because her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is gravely ill with croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne.md) hurries to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) using her past experience with Mrs. Hammond's children, saving the baby's life. Touched by Anne's rescue, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives her for the past incident with [Diana](../character/diana.md), allowing the two girls to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins her first day teaching school, forgetting her prepared speech but managing her new pupils, including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and a bright, imaginative boy named [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an excessively dressed Mrs. Donnell visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. On her walk home, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) wild orchids, brightening her mood before she returns to recount her day to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home through the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and meets [Diana](../character/diana.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing. After searching the well with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) breaks down in tears over his falsehoods, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reprimand him, send him to bed, and later laugh over his antics.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's passing, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts the opportunity with mixed emotions and resigns her teaching post, prompting reactions from her pupils and [Diana](../character/diana.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend
